mustFix.problem: Every image is a 'Placeholder for ...' grey box; dist references media/placeholder-*.webp
mustFix.fix: Resolve every [[img]] slot to a real file from niches/concrete/media/manifest.json (approved library) and rebuild; no placeholder-*.webp may remain in dist

mustFix.where: 1440-first.jpg header, 390-first.jpg header and mobile bar, every 1440-scroll-*.jpg
mustFix.problem: Phone/pin/clock SVG icons have no size, rendering 80-150px and blowing out the header call button and the mobile bar
mustFix.fix: Give every inline icon svg width/height attributes (20px in buttons, 24px in lists) plus CSS .icon{width:1.25em;height:1.25em;flex:none}; header call button back to a single ~48px-tall pill
min-width:0 on the grid children of .area__info and .tools__intro/.tools__panels; let .tabs__list wrap (flex-wrap:wrap) or overflow-x:auto inside its own box; check at 320
Render hours from the facts tokens: 'Mon–Thu 7–5:30 · Fri 7–4 · Sat 8–noon', en dashes

elevate.move: Art-direct the approved concrete frames as the ticket's attachments: hero photo stapled to the ticket with the carbon-blue offset copy behind it, story frames clip-revealed as each line item ticks so dig → base → steel → pour → cure reads as one shoot

Re-cut the phone page as a pocket ticket: compact header with one 48px call pill, hero ticket cropped tall to the slab, a slim two-button bar that hides on scroll down, and the process lines as stacked ticket stubs with no pin under 640px
